test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following was a famous sitar player?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Nikhil Banerjee__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• P**andit Nikhil Ranjan Banerjee **was an Indian **Classical sitarist who belongs to Maihar Gharana**.
 
• He has emerged as one of the leading exponents of the musical instrument Sitar.
 
• He was also the recipient of the Indian Civilian Honor Padma Bhushan.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• List of Famous Musicians with Instruments:__

 
 
• Tabla: **Ustad Zakir Hussain**, Tanmoy Bose, Swapan Chaudhuri
 
• Flute: **Hari Prasad Chaurasia**
 
• Violin player: **Raja Hossain Khan**
 
• Santoor: Pt Shiv Kumar Sharma
 
• Sarod: Allauddin Khan,Amjad Ali Khan.
 
• Sitar: Pt Ravi Shankar, Budhaditya Mukherjee.
 
• Surbahar: Annapurna Devi, Sajjad Hussain.
 
• Veena: Asad Ali Khan, Zia Moin-ud-din Khan.
